title: The Prisoner Exclusive Sneak Peek Marvel Custom 2009 AMC Promo Comic Caviezel
condition_description: Bright, light handling wear. See photos.
description:
The Prisoner - Exclusive Sneak Peek (2009), Marvel Custom Solutions promotional comic for the AMC mini-series starring Jim Caviezel and Ian McKellen. Marked "Not for Resale" on the cover - a giveaway promo, never sold in stores.

Back cover: The Prisoner AMC world premiere Nov 2009 ad ("Obey / Resist"), sponsored by Palm Pre.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
